title: Upgrading the SDK
content_data:
> **Note**
> Before upgrading the TikTok App Events SDK, review the latest changes in [Release history](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/tiktok-app-events-sdk-overview/v1.3) to understand any potential impact to your existing installation. ## Android ### 1. Upgrade your dependency #### 1.1 Maven Update the SDK version in your app-level `build.gradle`: ```xcodeblock (code curl http) dependencies { // Update the version number to the latest release implementation 'com.github.tiktok:tiktok-business-android-sdk:1.7.1' } (/code) ``` Sync your Gradle project to download the updated dependency. > **Note**
> Check the [GitHub releases page](https://github.com/tiktok/tiktok-business-android-sdk/releases) for the latest version number and any companion dependency version changes noted in the release notes. #### 1.2 Manual installation a. Download the latest `.aar` binary from the [GitHub releases page](https://github.com/tiktok/tiktok-business-android-sdk/releases/latest/). b. Replace the existing `.aar` file in your `app/libs` directory with the new one. c. Update the `implementation files(...)` line in your app-level `build.gradle` to match the new filename. d. Sync your Gradle project. ### 2. Recompile your app Clean and rebuild your project to ensure the new SDK version is picked up: ```xcodeblock (code curl http) ./gradlew clean assembleDebug (/code) ``` ### 3. Test and release a. Enable debug mode in your SDK configuration and launch the app. b. Verify events appear correctly in the [test events UI](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/android-integration-steps/v1.3#anchor-0-6), either via codeless test events or manually. c. Check for deprecation warnings in Logcat under the `TikTokBusinessSdk` tag. d. Once verified, disable debug mode, build a release variant, and distribute. ## iOS ### 1. Upgrade your dependency #### 1.1 CocoaPods To upgrade to the latest version, run: ```xcodeblock (code curl http) pod update TikTokBusinessSDK (/code) ``` Then run `pod install`. #### 1.2 Swift Package Manager a. In Xcode, go to your project's **Package Dependencies** tab. b. Select the `tiktok-business-ios-sdk` package. c. Update the version rule to the desired version or select **Up to Next Major Version**. d. Xcode will resolve and fetch the updated package automatically. #### 1.3 Manual installation a. Download the latest `TikTokBusinessSDK`framework from the [GitHub releases page](https://github.com/tiktok/tiktok-business-ios-sdk/releases/latest). Both static and dynamic frameworks are provided. b. Unzip the downloaded file. c. In your Xcode project, remove the existing `TikTokBusinessSDK.xcframework` from **Frameworks, Libraries, and Embedded Content**. d. Drag and drop the new `TikTokBusinessSDK.xcframework` into the same section. e. Ensure **Embed & Sign** is selected for the framework. ### 2. Recompile your app Clean your build folder (**Product → Clean Build Folder** or ⇧⌘K) and rebuild. If using CocoaPods, also run `pod install` after updating to ensure the workspace is in sync. ### 3. Test and release a. Enable debug mode in your SDK configuration and launch the app. b. Verify events appear correctly in the [test events UI](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/ios-integration-steps/v1.3#anchor-0-6), either via codeless test events or manually. c. Check the Xcode console for any deprecation warnings from `TikTokBusiness`. d. Once verified, disable debug mode, archive, and distribute. ## Unity ### 1. Get the latest Unity SDK package The Unity SDK is distributed as a `.unitypackage` file from the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/tiktok/tiktok-business-unity-sdk). To get the latest version: a. Go to [https://github.com/tiktok/tiktok-business-unity-sdk](https://github.com/tiktok/tiktok-business-unity-sdk). b. Download `TikTokBusinessSDK.unitypackage` from the repository root. > **Note**
> The Unity SDK does not use a package manager or versioned releases. The `.unitypackage` on the `main` branch is always the latest version. Check the repository commit history or the [Release history](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/tiktok-app-events-sdk-overview/v1.3) page to confirm what changed. ### 2. Replace the SDK in your Unity project **a. Remove the existing SDK.** In the Unity Editor Project window, right-click the `Assets/TikTokBusinessSDK` folder and select **Delete**. This ensures no stale scripts or native binaries remain from the previous version. ![Remove the existing SDK.](https://images.ctfassets.net/5jqet0ab9qci/5ONJAC8bfFCewrjLuOkL8K/298631486d8b674184002e5858102e8b/Remove_the_existing_SDK..png) **b. Import the new package.** Go to **Assets → Import Package → Custom Package**, select the downloaded `TikTokBusinessSDK.unitypackage`, then click **All** and **Import**. ![Go to Assets → Import Package → Custom Package](https://images.ctfassets.net/5jqet0ab9qci/5gboLiGwAV9yfHwCyBYSQB/a8645786c75075eac20c37c400b8af4e/5f9e1f32-f559-4ac7-9ea7-a3a24de4a475.png) ![Select the downloadedpackage, then click All and Import.](https://images.ctfassets.net/5jqet0ab9qci/IQQvNQ1mlcGOH9osf7hRY/c0ed0d65e2ca8c22ca32673820a25ec8/select_the_downloaded_TikTokBusinessSDK.unitypackage__then_click_All_and_Import..png) **c. Wait for recompilation.** Unity will recompile all scripts after import. Resolve any compiler errors before proceeding — errors typically indicate a naming or API change documented in the release history. > **Note**
> Do not import over the top of an existing `Assets/TikTokBusinessSDK` folder. Importing without deleting first can leave orphaned files that cause duplicate symbols or missing reference errors at build time. ### 3. Test and release a. Open your scene and perform a **Build and Run** targeting a test device (Android or iOS). b. Enable debug mode in your `TikTokConfig` and confirm events are logged: ```xcodeblock (code curl http) TikTokConfig config = new TikTokConfig(/*...*/); config.EnableDebugMode(); TikTokBusinessSDK.InitializeSdk(config); (/code) ``` c. Verify events appear correctly in the [test events UI](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/unity-integration-steps/v1.3#anchor-0-7), either via codeless test events or manually. d. Once verified, remove `config.EnableDebugMode()`, rebuild in release configuration, and distribute. ## React Native ### 1. Upgrade the npm package ```xcodeblock (code curl http) # Using npm npm install @tiktok-for-business/react-native-sdk@latest # Using Yarn yarn add @tiktok-for-business/react-native-sdk@latest (/code) ``` To upgrade to a specific version instead of `@latest`, replace it with the target version number (e.g. `@0.1.3`). ### 2. Rebuild and test ```xcodeblock (code curl http) # iOS npx react-native run-ios # Android npx react-native run-android (/code) ``` After rebuilding: - Verify events appear correctly in the [test events UI](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/react-native-installation/v1.3#anchor-0-7), either via codeless test events or manually. - Check for any deprecation warnings or breaking changes noted in the release history.
